rationale.A: ~730 m in mixed traffic on tram streets (Asemapäällikönkatu, Ratamestarinkatu, Kumpulantie), then a Teollisuuskatu-side track; 7 lights
rationale.B: Entirely on tracks beside Ratapihantie/Teollisuuskatu (50 km/h); no mixed traffic but all next to traffic; 7 lights
rationale.C: Tracks beside Aleksis Kiven katu and Teollisuuskatu, no mixed traffic; 7 lights
rationale.D: Through Vallilanlaakso park and quiet Hermanni streets; only Hermannin rantatie-side track; 5 lights, +2 min
rationale.E: 410 m in traffic on Aleksis Kiven katu, partly with tram rails; 7 lights
rationale.F: Same park route as D but longer beside Hermannin rantatie; 7 lights
rationale.G: Quiet Vallila streets but 260 m in traffic on Elimäenkatu, then a Teollisuuskatu-side track
rationale.H: Vallilanlaakso and quiet Kangasalantie, but a Hämeentie-side track and an unsignalised crossing of Hämeentie

notes: D wins both: it saves 2 lights for +2 min and moves most of the ride from tram streets and arterial-side tracks to park paths. H has 4 lights but costs +4 min.
